executor: Codex direct runner; Node 22 local checks, HTTP and real Chrome through CUA

authorization.request: May I fix these checks, publish the correction to this GoDaddy app, and retry catalog creation without changing your credentials?

fixes: Claude readiness requires parsed loggedIn=true, OAuth-token authentication and first-party API status; exit zero alone is insufficient.
Claude error envelopes cannot count as successful model calls or critiques.
Catalog failures reach the owner page as fixed safe categories instead of a generic request to check both subscriptions.
Authentication, quota and incompatible-CLI failures stop redundant probes; a model-specific 403 does not exclude later candidates.
Unexpected exceptions and database persistence failures remain private, preserve a previous valid catalog and do not reset credentials.
Fixed-category, bounded numeric diagnostics distinguish process launch failures from Claude API rejection without raw provider responses.
Claude HTTP 403 has a distinct error and marks Claude unavailable on the failed action response; Google and Codex sessions are unchanged.

dummy_token_command_check.auth_status: Reports OAuth token presence, not remote validity: a dummy token still yields loggedIn=true.
dummy_token_command_check.generation: The same isolated print flags execute and return API 401 for the dummy token on macOS.
dummy_token_command_check.limit: This is a CLI argument/schema check, not evidence of a working real subscription or GoDaddy network access.

deployment.preview_boundary: No Preview configuration changed. Existing production-plus-published-role gate remains intact.

live_attempts.purpose: Expose the previously discarded catalog failure category.
Distinguish a native/launch failure from a provider API rejection using private-data-free diagnostics.
Verify the explicit HTTP 403 result and classified error-array hint.

interpretation: The deployed Claude executable runs and reports an API 403 with an organization/account-related text category. It is not a native-module startup failure. The exact organization, token-scope, membership or network cause is not proven; no raw response or identity was retained.
remaining_action: Verify Claude account/organization access and, if authorized, reconnect only its subscription token. Current authorization explicitly excludes credential changes.
limitations: Catalog creation has not succeeded; this is not a complete application-readiness receipt.
A token-presence status check does not prove model access and can show ready again on a later GET. The failed catalog action carries the actual model-access result.
No application consultation, critique, Matrix product integration, full MySQL concurrency/restart or full U-04 UX checks were performed.
Existing baseline, canonical product documents and unit-completion claims were not changed.
evidence_handling: Only fixed categories, boolean/numeric results, code revisions and public documentation URLs are retained. No tokens, cookies, OAuth query, identity claims, raw CLI response or database content.
